name: Euphoric octave-jump lead
desc: Harvested from the synthwave musicscene's square lead: low-high octave leaps riding a I-vi-IV-V progression in A major, dotted-eighth delay halo, walk-up fill on the V bar; peak is a two-section arrange that flips from jumps to a cascading descant.

code.sparse: note("<[a4 ~ a5 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~] [f#4 ~ f#5 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~] [d4 ~ d5 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~] [e4 ~ e5 ~ ~ e5 ~ ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("square").attack(.01).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.15).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.5, ${cut}).slow(32)).gain(${gain}*.75).room(${room}).delay(".45:.375:.5").orbit(5).play()
code.full: note("<[a4 a5 ~ a5 ~ a5 ~ ~] [f#4 f#5 ~ f#5 ~ f#5 ~ ~] [d4 d5 ~ d5 ~ d5 ~ ~] [e4 e5 ~ e5 e5 e5 g#5 b5]>").add(note(${root})).s("square").attack(.005).decay(.2).sustain(.25).release(.1).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).delay(".4:.375:.5").lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: arrange([4, note("<[a4 a5 a5 a5 ~ a5 e5 a5] [f#4 f#5 f#5 f#5 ~ f#5 c#5 f#5] [d4 d5 d5 d5 ~ d5 a4 d5] [e4 e5 e5 e5 g#5 b5 e5 e6]>")], [4, note("<[a5 e5 c#5 e5 a5 e5 c#5 e5] [f#5 c#5 a4 c#5 f#5 c#5 a4 c#5] [d5 a4 f#4 a4 d5 a4 f#4 a4] [e5 b4 g#4 b4 e5 b4 g#4 e5]>")]).add(note(${root})).s("square").attack(.005).decay(.15).sustain(.22).release(.08).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.6).slow(8)).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).delay(".4:.375:.5").orbit(5).play()
